# Vendored frontend libraries

Copied from npm so the site has no CDN dependency. Source maps are stripped.

| Library | Version | Files | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GSAP | 3.15.1 | `gsap/` (core, ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Flip, CustomEase) | GSAP Standard License, free for all use: https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| Lenis | 1.3.27 | `lenis/lenis.min.js` | MIT (`lenis/LICENSE`) |
| three.js | 0.181.2 | `three/three.module.min.js`, `three/three.core.min.js` | MIT (`three/LICENSE`) |

Fonts in `static/fonts/` are Bricolage Grotesque and Newsreader (SIL Open Font License), from Fontsource.
